submit.introText: This service is free, anonymous, and supported by mycological experts. Your submissions help us improve knowledge and safety around mushroom foraging.
submit.introBullet1: You don't need to register or share personal information.
submit.introBullet2: Each mushroom must have 3 photos: top, side, and underside.
submit.introBullet3: You'll write a short comment about your find.
submit.introBullet4: After submission, you'll receive a reference code to track your report.
submit.introBullet5: A real expert will review your submission and send a response.
submit.title: Submit your mushroom inquiry
submit.referenceHint: Use this code to find your submission later:
submit.thankYouHint: You'll receive a reply as soon as an expert has reviewed your images. You can check right away by heading to the 'Check answer' page on the sidemenu and entering your reference code.
submit.addMushroomHint: Upload all three photos, in any order.
submit.readyDetail: Once you continue, you won't be able to return to this step.
submit.adminOnline: There are currently {count} mushrooms experts online
submit.noAdminsOnline: No mushroom experts are currently online

steps.title: Click the upload button below to add the first mushroom
steps.hint: Take one photo from the top, one from the side, and one from underneath. Good lighting and a neutral background help the identification. All metadata will be removed from the images when uploaded. This means all EXIF data, including GPS coordinates, will be stripped from the images to protect your privacy.

steps.title: Remember the reference code after submission
steps.hint: You'll receive a reference code when you submit. Use this code to check your results later.

steps.title: Our experts will review your photos
steps.hint: You'll get a response within 1-2 days. Use the reference code to check back.

stepDescription.top: Picture from the top of the mushroom. Make sure the cap is clearly visible.
stepDescription.side: Picture from the side of the mushroom. This helps to see the stem and gills.
stepDescription.under: Picture from the bottom of the mushroom. This shows the gills or pores.

validation.errorMushroomMissing: You must add at least one mushroom before submitting.

tooltips.completeRequest: Mark this request as finished and reviewed. The chat will be closed.
tooltips.putBackIntoQueue: Return this request to the main queue for review. It will not progress until someone else picks it up.
tooltips.placeOnHold: Temporarily hold the request without completing it. It will be removed from the queue but can be resumed later. Typically used for requests that need more information from the user.
tooltips.closeRequest: Closing the request will put it back in the queue for review if you are the request owner. If you are not the owner, nothing will happen.

loginUser.heading: Enter your reference code
loginUser.description: Paste the code you received after submitting your request to view its status and messages.

membership.title: Become a member - support Tryggere Ruspolitikk!
membership.intro: Would you like to help keep Soppidentifikasjon.no running and assist others with safe mushroom picking? As a member, you support our work in covering operational costs and compensating our mushroom experts.
membership.why1: Support the platform: Help maintain the website and keep our identification service free.
membership.why2: Learn about mushrooms: Gain access to exclusive content on mushroom identification, edible species, and lookalikes.
membership.why3: Become an expert: Members can apply to join our team of mushroom experts and assist others in safe identification.
membership.type1: Supporter: Contribute financially and get access to exclusive member content.
membership.type2: Expert member: For those with experience and knowledge, willing to identify mushrooms for our users.
membership.closing: Together, we make mushroom identification safer for everyone! Become a member today and support our mission.

support.title: Need help?
support.intro: Here you'll find answers to common questions and how to contact us.

faq1.question: How does the mushroom identification service work?
faq1.answer: You upload photos and receive a response within 1-2 days.

faq2.question: How do I use my reference code?
faq2.rest: and enter the code you received.

faq3.question: Can I request a new evaluation?
faq3.answer: Yes, upload new photos and submit a new request.
